command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged inputs against pinned sha256 (flye's own toy data, pinned to the 2.9.6 image tag) =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 65b7cbd9fb7ce90958d821d85c96ea078ee3ed4d446e02a07a9c1d29767dcbe2 ecoli_500kb_reads.fastq.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' de2efb0bdf2e880b769b53777fd6d300cf8b65a82dbb42ca6c8a0d279a97aa76 ecoli_500kb.fasta
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== flye assemble, single thread for reproducibility =="
# -t 1: flye's contig count varies with thread count (thread scheduling changes the
# assembly graph, the same class of nondeterminism iqtree documents). Single-threaded
# is deterministic here (3 contigs, byte-identical across 3 local runs).
flye --nano-hq ecoli_500kb_reads.fastq.gz -g 500k -t 1 -o out 2>&1 | tee flye.log
# Flatten the two artifacts we keep (never rm the staged inputs -- sticky /tmp EPERM).
cp out/assembly.fasta assembly.fasta
cp out/assembly_info.txt assembly_info.txt

# ---- smoke check ----
N=$(grep -c '^>' assembly.fasta)
TOT=$(awk '!/^>/{t+=length($0)}END{print t}' assembly.fasta)
BIG=$(awk '/^>/{if(s>m)m=s;s=0;next}{s+=length($0)}END{if(s>m)m=s;print m}' assembly.fasta)
REF=$(awk '!/^>/{t+=length($0)}END{print t}' ecoli_500kb.fasta)
DIFF=$(( BIG>REF ? BIG-REF : REF-BIG ))
{
  echo "contigs         $N     want exactly 3        (flye 2.9.6 --nano-hq -t1, deterministic)"
  echo "total_bp        $TOT   want exactly 466356"
  echo "largest_contig  $BIG   want ~420910; must recover the reference within 25 kb"
  echo "reference_bp    $REF   (419860 -- the toy E. coli region)"
  echo "largest_vs_ref  $DIFF  want <= 25000         (largest contig recovers the ~420 kb region)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$N"   -eq 3
test "$TOT" -eq 466356
test "$DIFF" -le 25000
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
